name: AI Migration
description: Fetches web pages and uses an AI provider to extract their content into structured Drupal entities via a Migrate Plus data parser, guided by JSON schema derived from the target content type.
project_description:
The AI Migration module is under active development. It helps migrate content into Drupal by using AI to parse web pages according to your Drupal content type schema, generating structured field data and creating Drupal nodes (or other entities) from it.

Goals: make it easier to turn unstructured content from web pages or documents into structured Drupal content ("fill the fields, not bloat the body"), make it easy to migrate slices of content to support phased migration of legacy sites, and spend less time tuning migrations.

How it works: the module supplies an 'ai' Migrate Plus data parser. For each configured source URL it fetches the HTML (via the migrate_plus http data fetcher), optionally cleans/reduces it with the document_loader_html_processor (Symfony HtmlSanitizer), derives a JSON schema from the destination entity type and bundle using the Schemata module, and sends the HTML plus schema to the configured AI chat provider. The provider returns a JSON:API-shaped object whose fields are mapped onto the destination entity by ordinary Migrate process plugins. Responses are cached in a dedicated cache bin keyed by prompt+provider+model to avoid repeat provider costs.

Requirements: drupal/ai ^1.2, drupal/migrate_plus, drupal/migrate_tools, drupal/document_loader_html_processor ^2.0 (brings document_loader and html_processor), drupal/schemata ^1.0, drupal/schemata_json_schema, core jsonapi/serialization, and league/commonmark (used to render the README on the help page). Recommended models include OpenAI GPT-4.1-mini, GPT-5-nano and Gemini 2.5 Flash. The ai_migration_example submodule ships ready-to-run sample migrations.

agent_skills.name: content-ai-migration
agent_skills.description: Runs an existing ai_migration migration using Drush. Asks for the migration ID, environment details, and desired flags before executing. Works in a chat window or an AI harness. Covers status checks, cache clearing, stuck-migration recovery, and post-run verification.
